scope: Read-only source/design review. No source edits, builds, tests, CI, push or runtime qualification.
answer: A fresh actual durable replacement of an independently justified latest-safe whole head plus the exact already-authorized R1 decision patch can establish THAT head durability. It cannot establish the prior write succeeded, resolve native CommitOutcomeUnknown, authorize another native xid, or alone provide range-isolated availability. Existing source lacks the safe-head/resolution producer.

confirmed_source_findings.finding: Whole original/candidate identity is checked before even verified fast-path; newer R2 whole head refuses. File IO success is recorded before readback/currentness; error leaves uncertainty and old outcome retained.

persist_or_restore restores old in-memory catalog after any write error; write_atomic uses FailClosed::No; an after-rename directory-sync error can leave newer visible disk with old memory. Thus neither memory-alone nor disk-alone is an authoritative safe head. This is a source-derived counterexample, not a newly observed physical failure.

One global unowned persistence-uncertain bool gates native catalogue durability, native read catalogue and normal writes. A full fresh fsync may physically settle accepted head bytes but cannot prove which unrelated operation has been completed. Existing synchronous service/store/journal scopes also do not isolate a stalled fsync.

Original Registered empty-hook/never-installed native policy and A/base/final/archive/lifetime checks remain essential. Materialized identity point is already selected physical base/log+actual abort identity; no blanket whole-catalogue bypass is needed or allowed.

Native remote committed-xid requires retained original outcome Committed before exact receipt/provenance/TxnStatus readback. Unknown stays unknown despite later status. Catalogue resolver must not promote or replace this native owner.

Remote future consumer needs distinct genuine remote admission, never DTO to localPrepared/Role cast. Registered scope cannot be revived after FIRST installed a writer.
necessary_safe_head_contract.head: Capture exact bounded CURRENT file bytes+verified envelope AND actual current memory under exclusive same-store mutation ownership. Equality is necessary for a healthy unrelated successor, but equality/checksum alone is NOT prior-fsync evidence. Own retained unknown O0/C0 disk-memory divergence must retain its exact original resolving path; do not universally require equality and thereby strand rename failures.
necessary_safe_head_contract.projection: Review full R1 obligation projection: ranges/log, backup fences, handoff promises, install intents, recovery fences, native bases, sparse decisions, install certifications/handovers, joint local state, abort protocol R1 slots, current joint recovery. Include global cluster/node/enforcement/profile/format/map-presence and abort StoreUUID; only explicitly supported monotonic format normalization. Unknown or changed selected/global obligations refuse.
necessary_safe_head_contract.generation: Before effects retain a distinct linked generation G1 with immutable parent G0/preimage/current safe-head bytes+checksum/R1 preimage and authorized postimage/native receipt checksum/xid/A identity/candidate bytes. Preserve all G0 outcomes exactly, including unknown. Bound generation count+bytes and one new attempt per actual fresh request; explicit exhaustion refusal, no eviction or retry-loop.
necessary_safe_head_contract.application: Candidate is H with ONLY authorized same-session R1 decision hashes patched. Never replay old whole C0 over H. If H already carries exact selected postimage and independently justified current durability, separate selected-completed-stage observation may avoid rewriting. It is not Serving or a grant.
necessary_safe_head_contract.resolution: Set uncertainty before actual IO. Retain actual return before readback/postchecks; exact new bytes and decoded full head readback; full physical/native/fresh metadata rechecks then short memory-only version publication. Old G0 succeeded flag remains unchanged. Record resolved-by-G1 explicitly; new fresh fsync proves G1 durability only.
necessary_safe_head_contract.foreign_uncertainty: Do not clear an unrelated owner merely because this operation has fresh OWN or disk==memory. Need typed same-store head/uncertainty ownership or full unresolved-intent inventory plus actual native constraints to justify all bytes; absent that, refuse without calling it bounded recovery.
necessary_safe_head_contract.availability: Whole-file writer serialization may still be necessary, but per-range read/write uncertainty and known-safe-head rules are needed before claiming unaffected R2 remains available during R1 stalls. Do not weaken current global refusal until those actual proofs exist.
necessary_safe_head_contract.cold: RAM generation history/owner is not restart recovery. Durable intent/head ancestry/native binding and fresh protected recovery producer remain required; no deserialize-to-authority.
